units.source_text: 千重子对苗子的话，有的地方也是似懂非懂……

en.t: Chieko found some parts of Naeko's words only half understandable...

units.source_text: 苗子说，秀男实际上是想和千重子结婚，由于不能如愿，只好死了心，

en.t: Naeko said that Hideo had really wanted to marry Chieko, but because that wish could not come true, he had no choice but to give up,

units.source_text: 转念于跟千重子一模一样的苗子，并想同苗子结婚。

en.t: and had turned his thoughts to Naeko, who looked exactly like Chieko, wanting to marry her instead.

units.source_text: 苗子的少女心敏锐地觉察到这点。

en.t: Naeko's girlish heart had keenly sensed this.

units.source_text: 于是，她向千重子说了一通“幻影论”。

en.t: So she spoke to Chieko at length about her theory of illusions.

units.source_text: 千重子心想：难道秀男真的要用苗子来慰藉他渴望自己的心情吗？

en.t: Chieko wondered: was Hideo really trying to use Naeko to console his longing for her?

units.source_text: 如果是这样，那就不算是秀男自负了。

en.t: If that was so, then it could not be called Hideo's conceit.
